figs.name: cathode-ray-oscilloscope-troubleshooting-flowchart
figs.alt: CRO troubleshooting flowchart for noise, triggering, distortion and phosphor burn in
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a troubleshooting path for common CRO errors: noisy trace, no triggering, distorted waveform and phosphor burn in, with the fix for each.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Troubleshooting flowchart for common CRO display errors</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">CRO Trace Problem? Check in This Order</text>
<rect x="60" y="48" width="280" height="40" rx="10" fill="#16a34a" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200.0" y="74.65" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Look at the trace</text>
<line x1="200" y1="88" x2="200" y2="110" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="200,112.0 350.0,145 200,178.0 50.0,145" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200" y="151.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Noisy trace?</text>
<line x1="350" y1="145" x2="393" y2="145" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="372" y="136" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="395" y="109" width="385" height="72" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="587.5" y="139.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Use proper grounding, adjust time base,</text>
<text x="587.5" y="162.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">apply input filters if needed</text>
<text x="212" y="199" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<line x1="200" y1="178" x2="200" y2="210" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="200,212.0 350.0,245 200,278.0 50.0,245" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200" y="251.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Not triggering?</text>
<line x1="350" y1="245" x2="393" y2="245" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="372" y="236" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="395" y="209" width="385" height="72" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="587.5" y="239.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Adjust trigger level and coupling,</text>
<text x="587.5" y="262.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">check trigger source and channel</text>
<text x="212" y="299" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<line x1="200" y1="278" x2="200" y2="310" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="200,312.0 350.0,345 200,378.0 50.0,345" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200" y="351.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Distorted shape?</text>
<line x1="350" y1="345" x2="393" y2="345" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="372" y="336" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="395" y="309" width="385" height="72" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="587.5" y="339.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Check vertical sensitivity setting,</text>
<text x="587.5" y="362.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">interference and probe connection</text>
<text x="212" y="399" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<line x1="200" y1="378" x2="200" y2="410" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="200,412.0 350.0,445 200,478.0 50.0,445" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200" y="451.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Phosphor burn in?</text>
<line x1="350" y1="445" x2="393" y2="445" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="372" y="436" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="395" y="409" width="385" height="72" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="587.5" y="439.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Reduce brightness, use screensaver,</text>
<text x="587.5" y="462.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">or replace the screen if needed</text>
<text x="212" y="499" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<line x1="200" y1="478" x2="200" y2="515" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="517" width="280" height="50" rx="10" fill="#14532d" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200.0" y="548.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Trace OK, take readings</text>
</svg>
